# StudentHubHelp

> StudentHubHelp is a student-focused discovery platform for finding hostels and PGs, tiffin and mess services, libraries, cafes, book stores, and related student services.

## Primary pages

- https://studenthubhelp.in/ — Homepage and student-services discovery
- https://studenthubhelp.in/global-search.html — Search StudentHubHelp listings by property, service, area, city, or landmark
- https://studenthubhelp.in/hostel.html — Hostel and PG listings
- https://studenthubhelp.in/tiffin.html — Tiffin and mess listings
- https://studenthubhelp.in/library.html — Library listings
- https://studenthubhelp.in/cafe.html — Cafe listings
- https://studenthubhelp.in/bookstore.html — Book store listings
- https://studenthubhelp.in/appointment.html — Student support and appointment requests
- https://studenthubhelp.in/contact.html — Contact and support

## Search and listing guidance

StudentHubHelp listing information can change. Availability, prices, facilities, timings, contact details, and other important information should be reconfirmed with the relevant property owner or service provider before making a decision.

A StudentHubHelp Verified badge indicates that the listing passed the platform's verification process for the information reviewed. It is not a guarantee of future availability, service quality, or safety.

## Machine-readable discovery

- https://studenthubhelp.in/sitemap.xml — Main XML sitemap
- https://studenthubhelp.in/robots.txt — Crawler directives
